purpose: Teach: アポロ/ライナー/ゼット/ナカ/シマ/鞭/ハンドブック/さらし

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、アポロ、絶対、計画の、絶対、ドキュメンタリー、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、見たわよ
lines.en: Aoi, I'm serious — I saw that Apollo documentary you were planning to show me.
lines.style: Warm opening, slightly teasing. Quick rhythm, almost conspiratorial. Eyes bright with affection and the pleasure of sharing something she noticed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。野球の、本気で、絶対、ライナー、絶対、葵、絶対、お父さんと、絶対、よく、絶対、見るのよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, I know — you and Dad watch baseball replays together all the time. You're always so into those slow-motion liners.
lines.style: Easy, conversational warmth. Light laugh underneath. Relaxed pace. The comfort of knowing someone well enough to reference their habits without judgment.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、頭文字、絶対、ゼット、絶対、なんていう、絶対、デザインのロゴ、絶対、お洒落よね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, that logo with the initial Z is so well-designed. Really tasteful.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Slower pace — she's genuinely noticing something. Slight smile in the voice. A moment of genuine appreciation, not performing it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、ナカイ、絶対、さん、絶対、よく、絶対、来てくださるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That's Nakai-san — he comes into the shop really often. He's become kind of a regular.
lines.style: Bright recognition in the voice. Natural conversational beat. A small proud note — the warmth of noticing regulars and feeling they belong somewhere.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、シマウマ、絶対、柄の、絶対、エプロン、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、可愛いと思うわ
lines.en: That zebra-striped apron you wear is so cute. I think it suits you perfectly.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, no performance. Tender underlying tone. Slow enough to let the compliment land. The voice of someone noticing something small and wanting to say it aloud.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 昔の、本気で、絶対、鞭、絶対、職人技、絶対、博物館で、絶対、葵、絶対、見たよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Actually, I saw whipmaking on display at a museum once. The craftsmanship was incredible.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant. Speaking from memory. Slower pace, as if she's picturing it. Warm but introspective — sharing something that stayed with her.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店の、絶対、ハンドブック、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、お洒落と思うわ
lines.en: Your shop's handbook is beautiful too. Really elegant design throughout.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, simple delivery. Steady pace. The tone of someone who pays attention to details and wants to acknowledge what's well-made.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵のお店、本気で、絶対、暖簾の、絶対、さらし布、絶対、季節ごとに、絶対、替えているよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The noren at your shop — the way you change the cloth with the seasons is such a thoughtful touch.
lines.style: Warm, almost tender. Speaking with quiet recognition of care. Slower pace. The voice of someone who notices when people put thought into small things.
